name: How much does a luxury pool add to home value in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Does a high-end custom pool increase resale value enough to justify the cost in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Does a high-end custom pool increase resale value enough to justify the cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury pool can make a property more attractive, especially in Los Angeles neighborhoods where outdoor living is a major selling point. However, the resale impact depends on how well the pool fits the home, the size of the lot, and buyer expectations in that neighborhood. A beautiful pool with coordinated landscaping, decking, and entertaining space usually has more appeal than a pool that feels oversized or disconnected from the house. The best value tends to come from durable design, low-maintenance systems, and a layout that enhances the overall property. Homeowners should think of the pool as part of a broader outdoor investment rather than a dollar-for-dollar resale guarantee. In premium markets, a well-executed luxury pool can strengthen demand and help the home stand out, but it should still be designed for the property, not just for resale.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury pool can improve market appeal, but the value gain depends on neighborhood demand, lot size, design quality, and how well the pool matches the home. A poorly placed or overbuilt pool may add less value than a well-integrated outdoor living space.
